items.title: M0: protocol freeze tool with machine-validated protocol.json and sha256 protocol hash
items.context: Create experiments/experience-ablation/protocol.mjs exposing a CLI (node protocol.mjs freeze|validate|hash --root=<repoRoot> --experimentId=<id> --config=<path>) plus library functions. protocol.json fields (schemaVersion 'proofbound.experience-ablation-protocol.v1'): experimentId; taskClasses (the six in-store trap classes + heldOut + clean group membership lists); perPopulation sample-size config (seeded: alpha 0.05, power 0.80, baselineBand [0.5,0.8], mdeBand [0.25,0.35]; live: alpha 0.05, power 0.80, baseline 0.30, mde 0.10); pilotFreezeRule {minControlFaultRuns: 15, freezeAt: 'wilson95Lower', maxCiWidth: 0.30}; noOverclaimBoundaryRef (pointer to plan S15); memorySnapshotHash (sha256 over the runtime memory store snapshot supplied as a directory or file list — freeze records it; validate re-checks presence, not re-hashing live stores); createdAt accepted as an input parameter (never Date.now inside the hashed payload). protocolHash = sha256 of the canonical JSON serialization (stable key order, hash field excluded). freeze writes .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/protocol.json + memory-snapshot-hash.json; validate exits non-zero on any missing/malformed field or hash mismatch. Hermetic selfcheck experiments/experience-ablation/protocol-selfcheck.mjs covers: valid freeze -> validate passes; tampered field -> hash mismatch fails; missing memorySnapshotHash -> fails; hash stability across key reordering.
items.userSees: Running node experiments/experience-ablation/protocol.mjs freeze --root=<tmp> --experimentId=exp1 --config=<cfg.json> prints the computed protocolHash and writes .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/exp1/protocol.json plus memory-snapshot-hash.json under the given root; node protocol.mjs validate --root=<tmp> --experimentId=exp1 exits 0 and prints PASS on the frozen protocol, and exits non-zero naming the offending field after any tamper; node experiments/experience-ablation/protocol-selfcheck.mjs prints a per-case PASS list and exits 0.

happy.desc: freeze on a valid config then validate -> exit 0, protocol.json + memory-snapshot-hash.json exist under the experiment root, printed protocolHash equals the stored one; WHY: M0 exit criterion protocol.json validates

edge.desc: canonicalization: freezing two configs that differ only in JSON key order -> identical protocolHash; tampering any single field -> validate exits non-zero with hash mismatch; WHY: hash stability is the binding the ledger and future runs depend on
missing memorySnapshotHash or malformed perPopulation config -> freeze/validate exits non-zero naming the field; WHY: machine-validated means every required field is enforced, not documented

adversarial.desc: timestamps: createdAt is supplied as input and excluded from the hashed payload -> re-freezing the same config at a different time yields the same protocolHash; WHY: Date.now in hashed payloads breaks reproducibility (repo-wide resume lesson)

verificationEvidence.note: Live CLI run: freeze printed protocolHash ed4c18c5... and wrote protocol.json + memory-snapshot-hash.json under the experiment root; validate exited 0 printing PASS with the same hash. Also covered by protocol-selfcheck case freeze->validate.
Selfcheck cases: key-order invariance (reversed insertion order -> identical protocolHash) and tampered field -> validate hash mismatch (PROTOCOL_HASH_MISMATCH). 13/13 cases pass.

Selfcheck cases: missing memorySnapshotHash named; malformed perPopulation (inverted baselineBand) named; in-store/held-out overlap rejected; wrong schemaVersion rejected — every required field enforced with the offending field in the error.
Selfcheck case: same config frozen at createdAt 2026-01-01 vs 2026-12-31 -> identical protocolHash, and createdAt stored outside the hashed payload (extractPayload drops it).

items.title: M2: immutable pair ledger with deterministic seeded run order
items.context: Create experiments/experience-ablation/pair-ledger.mjs exposing a CLI (node pair-ledger.mjs build|verify --root=<repoRoot> --experimentId=<id> --manifest=<path> --seed=<string>) plus library functions. build requires an existing frozen protocol.json with a valid protocolHash (refuses otherwise — this mechanically enforces M0's no-task-without-hash exit criterion) and writes: fixture-manifest.jsonl (one row per fixture: fixtureId, trapClass, trapGroup in_store|held_out|clean, oracleRef; fixtures need not exist on disk yet — M1 builds them), pair-ledger.jsonl (one row per fixture pair: pairId=fixtureId, the two arm-run slots control|treatment, status pending), and run-order-seed.json ({seed, runOrder: [...armRunIds]}) where runOrder comes from xmur3(seed)+mulberry32+Fisher-Yates over all arm-runs (the run-driver.mjs pattern, re-implemented locally). Determinism: same seed + same manifest -> byte-identical runOrder. Immutability: build and any mutating operation refuse with a clear error when score-records.jsonl exists in the experiment root; verify re-derives the runOrder from the stored seed and fails on any divergence, and fails if the stored protocolHash no longer matches protocol.json. Hermetic selfcheck experiments/experience-ablation/pair-ledger-selfcheck.mjs covers: same-seed reproducibility; different-seed divergence; refusal without frozen protocol; refusal after a score record exists; verify catches a tampered ledger row.
items.userSees: Running node experiments/experience-ablation/pair-ledger.mjs build --root=<tmp> --experimentId=exp1 --manifest=<fixtures.json> --seed=s1 writes fixture-manifest.jsonl, pair-ledger.jsonl (one pending control+treatment slot pair per fixture), and run-order-seed.json with a deterministic runOrder; rerunning build with the same seed prints an identical runOrder; build without a frozen protocol.json exits non-zero with a refusal message naming M0; build or any mutating call after score-records.jsonl exists exits non-zero with an immutability refusal; node pair-ledger.mjs verify re-derives the order and exits non-zero on any tampered row; node experiments/experience-ablation/pair-ledger-selfcheck.mjs prints a per-case PASS list and exits 0.

happy.desc: build on a frozen protocol root with a 6-fixture manifest -> three files written, runOrder covers every armRun exactly once, same seed rebuild -> byte-identical runOrder; WHY: M2 exit criterion same seed reproduces assignments

edge.desc: different seed -> different runOrder (and a permutation of the same armRun set); manifest row missing trapGroup -> build refuses naming the field; WHY: the order must be seed-driven and the manifest schema machine-enforced
build without protocol.json (or with protocolHash mismatch) -> refusal naming the frozen-protocol requirement; WHY: mechanically enforces M0 no-task-without-protocol-hash
verify after protocol.json is modified post-build -> exits non-zero with protocolHash mismatch; WHY: verify must detect protocol drift after ledger creation, not only at build time

adversarial.desc: after touching score-records.jsonl in the experiment root, build and any mutating operation refuse; verify on a hand-tampered pair-ledger.jsonl row exits non-zero; WHY: M2 exit criterion assignment cannot change after a score exists

verificationEvidence.command: node experiments/experience-ablation/pair-ledger.mjs build --root=$TMPR --experimentId=exp-cli-demo --manifest=$TMPR/manifest.json --seed=s1 (twice) && diff outputs && node experiments/experience-ablation/pair-ledger.mjs verify --root=$TMPR --experimentId=exp-cli-demo
verificationEvidence.note: Live CLI: two same-seed builds produced identical runOrder+sealHash (diff empty); verify PASS with 6 arm-runs bound to the protocol hash. Selfcheck additionally proves runOrder covers every armRun exactly once (17/17 cases).

Selfcheck cases: different seed -> different order over the same armRun permutation set; manifest row missing trapGroup refused naming the field; duplicate fixtureId and invalid trapGroup also refused.

Live CLI on a root with NO frozen protocol: exit 1 with 'frozen-protocol requirement not met ... M0 requires a valid frozen protocol.json' — the M0 no-task-without-hash exit criterion enforced mechanically. Selfcheck covers the same plus hash-mismatch refusal.
Selfcheck case: protocol.json tampered AFTER a valid build -> verify exits non-zero (protocolHash no longer matches the frozen protocol); restores -> verify passes again.

Live CLI: after score-records.jsonl exists, build exits 1 with 'the ledger is immutable once the first score record exists (plan S8/M2)'. Selfcheck also proves verify catches a hand-tampered pair-ledger.jsonl row and a tampered run-order-seed.json (sealHash).

items.title: M5: per-population sample-size calculator with adequacy report
items.context: Create experiments/experience-ablation/sample-size.mjs exposing a CLI (node sample-size.mjs report --config=<protocol.json path or inline params> --out=<dir>) plus pure library functions: twoProportionNPerArm(p1, mde, alpha, power) using the pooled two-sided z formula with treatment = baseline MINUS mde (reduction direction — the direction mistake is a known reviewer trap from B-36fd review round 2); mcnemarDiscordantPairs(p01, p10, alpha, power) for the paired design (Connor/Miettinen discordant-pair approximation with the standard formula, documented in a comment); wilson95(successes, n) returning {lower, upper, width}; pilotFreezeCheck(defects, n, rule) implementing the S7 freeze rule (>=15 runs required, freeze N computed at the Wilson lower bound, extend flag when width > 0.30). report writes adequacy-report.json + adequacy-report.md showing, per population (seeded band scan at 0.025 grid resolution + live point): planned N per arm, assumptions, detectable effect, and the in-band maximum with its location. Hermetic selfcheck experiments/experience-ablation/sample-size-selfcheck.mjs asserts the reviewed anchor values from the plan's S7: n(0.30, 0.10) rounds up to 294; n(0.625, 0.25) rounds up to 62; n(0.5, 0.35) = 27; n(0.5, 0.25) = 58; band maximum over baseline 0.5-0.8 x MDE 0.25-0.35 = 62 near baseline 0.625/MDE 0.25; wilson95 sanity (e.g. 9 defects of 15 runs -> CI containing 0.6, lower bound < 0.6, width reported); pilotFreezeCheck rejects n < 15 and flags extend when width > 0.30. The selfcheck is the story's red test: it fails before the tool exists and passes after.
items.userSees: Running node experiments/experience-ablation/sample-size.mjs report --config=<protocol.json> --out=<dir> writes adequacy-report.json and adequacy-report.md showing per population (seeded band grid + live point) the planned N per arm, assumptions (alpha, power, direction: treatment = baseline minus MDE), detectable effect, and the in-band maximum with its location; the md report states 294 for the live point and 62 as the seeded in-band maximum near baseline 0.625 / MDE 0.25; node experiments/experience-ablation/sample-size-selfcheck.mjs prints a per-case PASS list and exits 0.

happy.desc: anchor values: nPerArm(0.30,0.10)=294, nPerArm(0.625,0.25)=62, nPerArm(0.5,0.35)=27, nPerArm(0.5,0.25)=58 (ceil, pooled two-sided z, alpha .05, power .80, reduction direction); band scan maximum = 62 near baseline 0.625/MDE 0.25; WHY: these are the plan-reviewed S7 anchors, triple-verified in the B-36fd review

edge.desc: wilson95(9,15) -> lower < 0.6 < upper with width reported; pilotFreezeCheck(defects,n<15) -> rejects with min-runs message; pilotFreezeCheck with CI width > 0.30 -> extend flag true; WHY: the S7 freeze rule must be executable, not prose

mcnemar discordant-pair sizing is monotonic: increasing the discordant probability (p01+p10) while holding the ratio fixed does not increase the required pair count; formula variant (Connor or Miettinen) documented in a source comment; WHY: monotonicity is a sanity invariant that catches formula transcription errors without depending on a disputed literature constant

adversarial.desc: direction trap: an increase-direction computation (treatment = baseline + MDE) at (0.30,0.10) would give 356 not 294 - the selfcheck asserts 294 so any direction flip fails; WHY: the exact mistake Codex made in B-36fd review round 2 must be structurally impossible to ship

verificationEvidence.note: Selfcheck asserts the plan-reviewed S7 anchors exactly: n(0.30,0.10)=294, n(0.625,0.25)=62, n(0.5,0.35)=27, n(0.5,0.25)=58 (ceil, pooled two-sided z, alpha .05, power .80, reduction direction), and the band-scan maximum 62 at (0.625, 0.25). 24/24 cases pass.

Selfcheck cases: wilson95(9,15) lower<0.6<upper with width>0.30 driving the extend flag; pilotFreezeCheck rejects n<15 with min_runs; extend flagged when width>0.30; tight-CI case freezes at the Wilson lower bound with a conservative frozen N.

Selfcheck cases: mcnemar larger asymmetry at fixed total discordance -> fewer pairs; same asymmetry with more discordance -> more pairs; zero asymmetry rejected. Formula variant documented in-code (Connor 1987 reference comment).

Direction-trap case: the deliberately wrong increase-direction math (baseline+MDE) reproduces 356 while the tool computes 294 — any direction flip in the implementation fails the 294 assertion. The report CLI also states the reduction direction in json and md.
